observations.notes: Record FY25-26 (ended Mar-26): Revenue AED 150.5bn ($41.0bn, +3% YoY), EBITDA AED 41.1bn ($11.2bn), PBT AED 24.4bn ($6.6bn), PAT AED 21.0bn ($5.7bn), record cash AED 59.6bn ($16.2bn).

verdict.stance: Overweight / Sovereign Flagship Aviation Cash Fortress ($16.2bn Cash)
verdict.summary: The Emirates Group (100% Investment Corporation of Dubai) delivered record FY25-26 revenue of AED 150.5bn ($41.0bn), EBITDA of AED 41.1bn ($11.2bn, 27.3% margin), and PAT of AED 21.0bn ($5.7bn). Record cash reserves of AED 59.6bn ($16.2bn) allow Emirates to self-fund widebody fleet deliveries while retiring legacy debt.

positives: Record AED 59.6bn ($16.2bn) cash pile provides fortress liquidity and net-cash balance sheet.
Industry-leading AED 41.1bn ($11.2bn) EBITDA and 27.3% EBITDA margin on global long-haul hub dominance.
100% owned by Investment Corporation of Dubai (ICD), core strategic asset for Dubai's economy.
negatives: Unrated by S&P/Moody's/Fitch, limiting IG index inclusion for unrated tranches.
High sensitivity to jet fuel price spikes and Middle East airspace disruptions.
Massive multi-year Boeing 777X / Airbus A350 fleet capex and Dubai World Central (DWC) hub transition.

background.business_overview: World's largest international airline (Emirates) and global airport/ground-handling provider (dnata).
background.asset_perimeter: Widebody fleet (A380, B777, A350), Emirates SkyCargo, dnata global ground/catering.
background.ownership_governance: 100% owned by Investment Corporation of Dubai (Government of Dubai).

recent_drivers: FY25-26 (Mar-26): Record revenue AED 150.5bn ($41.0bn), EBITDA AED 41.1bn ($11.2bn), PAT AED 21.0bn ($5.7bn).
Cash balance surged to all-time high AED 59.6bn ($16.2bn), self-funding fleet capex.

catalysts.impact: Tracks winter peak load factors and fuel hedging.
Updates cash pile, dividend to ICD, and Boeing/Airbus delivery capex.

management_guidance_tracker.management_target: Self-fund aircraft deliveries from internal cash flow
management_guidance_tracker.variance_analysis: Record profitability keeps balance sheet net cash.

management_questions.question: Confirm total gross lease + financial debt at 31-Mar-26 and H1 FY27 dividend distributions to ICD.
Detail Boeing 777X delivery delays and 2027-2029 fleet capex commitments.
Indicate any plans for benchmark USD Sukuk or EETC issuance ahead of DWC expansion.
